requirements.summary: Build the current Draft Version 133 codebase without modifications
acceptanceCriteria: The admin button is visible in the header as it was in Version 133

file_operations.description: Verify the App.tsx routing structure is intact with all existing routes (home, blog, shop, admin, tools pages) and hash-based navigation functioning correctly
Verify the Header component displays the admin button correctly when user is authenticated and has admin role, ensuring navigation links for home, blog, shop, and tools are present
Verify the HomePage layout renders all sections (hero, blog, shop, contact) correctly with proper component integration and blog post click handling
Verify the AdminDashboard is accessible and displays all management interfaces (blog posts, users, media, tools, settings) with proper query hooks and upload components
Verify the base HTML structure is correct with proper root div and main TypeScript entry file reference
Verify React app initialization with React Query and Internet Identity providers is functioning correctly

requirements.summary: Deploy the built application to the Internet Computer network for testing
acceptanceCriteria: Application is deployed and accessible via canister URL

file_operations.description: Verify the deployment script runs backend binding generation, frontend build, and canister deployment with retry logic and logging to deploy-logs directory
Verify deployment step utilities handle logging, output capture, and transient failure detection correctly for reliable deployment execution
